## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes (and `make test`, if `tools/` changed)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) under the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/)
- [ ] Factual claims link to sources, and "Last reviewed" dates are updated where facts were checked
- [ ] No third-party copyrighted material (screenshots, logos, character art, ripped assets, long quotes)
- [ ] Outside material follows `docs/sourcing-and-originality.md`: facts checked at the original source, our own words, quotations of 40 words or fewer with links, and ideas credited
- [ ] No confidential or NDA information
- [ ] No personal data or secrets, including in test files
- [ ] Any problem status changes are reflected in both the problem doc and `problems/README.md`
- [ ] Any agent-written content was reviewed by me, and the pull request says an agent helped
- [ ] Changes to guardrail files (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `skills/`, `tools/`, `.github/`, `.claude/`) are called out above
